models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: UD-Q4_K_XL + Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2-Q4_K_M drafter, Q8_0 KV cache at 90K context; 79.71 tok/s at 120K with --spec-draft-n-max 4 (native MTP 70.83 at 100K)
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp PR #27342 build, --spec-type draft-dflash --spec-draft-n-max 3 -c 150000 -ngl 99 -ctv q4_0 -ctk q4_0

models.why: Single RTX 4090, llama.cpp PR #27342: DFlash2 beats native MTP on decode at equal KV precision (80.76 vs 70.83 tok/s at ~100K, 77.44 vs 66.85 at 150K with Q4_0 KV) while giving up prefill speed (~1,750 vs ~2,360 tok/s).

models.name: Bonsai 2 27B

engines.quant: 5.9GB ternary weights with Q4_0/Q3_0 KV cache; bonsai-ada-surgery recipe, 60.4 tok/s at 245K context

models.why: 5.9GB ternary 27B serving its trained 262K context on a 12GB card: the MIT-licensed bonsai-ada-surgery recipe hits 60.4 tok/s at 245K on an RTX 4070 12GB with Q4_0/Q3_0 KV and 158/164 on HumanEval.
